_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT -- read by tools/stage-sp11-boot-media.py. Only 'shell' is enforced (hard refusal on mismatch): it is the one public, externally-pinned binary. The *_reference entries are informational only (advisory, never refused) because slbounce/sltest are local, toolchain-dependent builds from source; see REPORT.md for why. tcblaunch.exe is deliberately absent: which build works on SP11 is unknown until hardware bring-up, so no hash expectation is recorded for it.

shell.role: aarch64 UEFI Shell staged at EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI
shell.notes: Not Microsoft-signed; operator must disable Secure Boot (plan docs/SURFACE-PRO-11.md section 8). Built from public edk2-stable202608 by the project's GitHub Actions workflow; OBSERVED booting in QEMU+EDK2 on this host (see REPORT.md Validation).

slbounce_reference.role: slbounce EFI runtime driver, local build staged at SP11/SLBOUNCE.EFI
slbounce_reference.enforcement: advisory only -- tools/stage-sp11-boot-media.py never refuses on mismatch here
slbounce_reference.notes: Reproduced identically on this host across a clean rebuild and a build from a different absolute path; a toolchain change is expected to change this hash, which is why it is not a hard pin.

sltest_reference.role: slbounce self-test EFI application, local build staged at SP11/SLTEST.EFI
sltest_reference.build_flags: SLBOUNCE_ALWAYS_SWITCH=1 DEBUG=1 CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-elf- (flag has no effect on this binary)
sltest_reference.enforcement: advisory only -- tools/stage-sp11-boot-media.py never refuses on mismatch here
sltest_reference.notes: Byte-identical with or without SLBOUNCE_ALWAYS_SWITCH=1 (src/test_main.c does not read that macro); same commit as slbounce_reference.
